verdict: Pass, 8/10. Real voice and sound are in both cuts, hi and en differ, loudness is on target, every line is intelligible to whisper.cpp in the full mix, every clip lands where the timeline puts it, 27 of 29 cues start within 0.2 s of speech, and the regenerated s05/s06/s09 fix the round-2 bag, phone and face findings. There are no blocking issues. Six minor fixes remain, listed below. Nobody listened: performance, emotion and how the mix feels are not judged.

sync.basis: Envelope cross-correlation puts all 20 dialogue clips at the timeline position (lag 0 ms; one at 10 ms). Cue start against measured speech: 18 of 20 lines within 0.06 s. audio_levels.basis: I -14.3 LUFS (target -14 +-1) and true peak -1.1 dBFS, below the -1 dBTP ceiling. whisper.cpp small transcribes all 10 lines from the full mix in both languages, so the dialogue is intelligible over the bed. Momentary loudness is -10 to -15 LUFS on dialogue and -30 to -44 in the rain-only gaps. The ring runs 5-8 LU above dialogue at -6 LUFS momentary; the script asks for 'far too loud'. In the low band (<120 Hz), the extra duck under the second half of l08 shows as a 10-15 dB drop (hi 25.5-28.5 s, en 25.5-28 s). The general -8 dB dialogue duck cannot be separated from voice energy in the mix trace.

phone_filter.basis: Measured on voice/phonefx against the clean takes: below 250 Hz is down 9-11 dB, above 4 kHz is down 5-11 dB, and overall loudness is within 1 dB. The filter is present but moderate. Consonants survive: whisper hears every caller word through it ('who he is driving' exact on the filtered en l08). The audible character (enough 'phone' against Tara's clean voice) is unheard.

music.basis: Against script music_note: there is no music before the first ring (the drone enters at the ring, hi 10.57 s, en 10.70 s), the drone has an extra duck under the l08 question, there is no music under the lock clunk (the drone ends at s07, the sting starts 2.1 s after the clunk), and the sting sits under l10. Audio goes to silence within one frame of the cut to black (hi 36.69 s against 36.667, en 35.49 against 35.467). The sub-pulse 'heartbeat from b5' was not found, so it is unverified.

sound_effects.basis: Confirmed in the mix at the timeline frame by cross-correlation (lag 0, r 0.77-0.99): ring on the s03 cut, key click (high band), call-end beeps on l08's last speech, lock clunk on the s08 cut, headlight click on the s09 cut, ignition. Beats match the script. The zip's loud finish (3.0-3.5 s into the file) falls on the s01/s02 cut, but most of it is buried under l01 (expected). Two misses: the paper rustle at the reveal measures at about rain-bed level (file RMS -42 to -46 dB at -14 dB gain), and the ring is not 'cut dead by the key click': its tail ends 13 frames (hi) or 4 frames (en) before the click.

Line breaks hold in burn-in (c01 in hi and en). Devanagari and mixed-script lines shape correctly in the review frames.
